descriptionHtml:
This romantic bridesmaid dress features a deep V neckline, empire waist flutter sleeves, and subtle high low tulle hemline. It is friendly to most body types. We think this elegant formal evening dress is perfect for all occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming and graduation!


Classic Version:Chiffon Evening Dress


Fit:Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure:It is Concealed Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments:It is Not Padded, with Lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises Polyester.


Stretch:Fabric is No Stretch.
